title: Java 8 Features
description: Explore Java 8 features that make Java development more expressive and efficient. Learn functional programming with functional interfaces, lambda expressions, method references, and interface enhancements. Use the Stream API to process collections, the Date and Time API to handle dates and times, and Optional to reduce null-related errors.

topics.title: Functional Interfaces and Lambda Expressions
topics.description: Understand functional programming in Java 8 and write concise implementations using lambda expressions.
subtopics: Built-in interfaces: Predicate, Function, Consumer, and Supplier

topics.title: Interface Enhancements and Method References
topics.description: Learn Java 8 interface enhancements and use method references as a concise alternative to certain lambda expressions.
subtopics: Static, instance, and constructor method references

topics.title: Stream API and Collection Processing
topics.description: Process and transform collection data using Stream API operations and collectors.
subtopics: Creating streams from collections and arrays
Intermediate operations: filter, map, sorted, distinct, and limit
Terminal operations: forEach, collect, count, reduce, and min/max

topics.title: Java 8 Date and Time API
topics.description: Use the java.time API to work with dates, times, durations, periods, and formatting.
subtopics: Limitations of legacy Date and Calendar APIs
Date and time formatting with DateTimeFormatter
Parsing and comparing dates and times

topics.title: Optional Class and Null Handling
topics.description: Use Optional to represent potentially absent values and reduce common null-related errors.
subtopics: Creating Optional objects: of, ofNullable, and empty
Checking values with isPresent and isEmpty
Handling values with ifPresent, orElse, orElseGet, and orElseThrow
Transforming values with map and flatMap
